messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] HADOOP_HOME deprecated
parts:
well, HADOOP_{BIN/HOME} is required to locate hadoop binary

so things are run via $HADOOP_BIN/hadoop, if $HADOOP_BIN is not
found,and $HADOOP is, then $HADOOP_BIN=$HADOOP/bin/

and then hadoop is called as $HADOOP_BIN/hadoop.

Its all best attempt to locate hadoop binary. Are you having issues?


On Wed, Jul 4, 2012 at 12:06 AM, Gourav Sengupta
<gourav....@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> while starting Rhipe we need to set HADOOP_BIN because setting HADOOP_HOME
> does not work any more with HADOOP_HOME now deprecated. Even setting HADOOP
> environment variable does not work and the only work around is setting
> HADOOP_BIN.
>
> Is this observation right?
>
> Regards,
> Gourav Sengupta
